coefficient_quantiles: Retained per unit; not averaged into pooled quantiles

metric_definitions.signed_bias: mean(prediction - exact truth) over repeat-prompt cells
metric_definitions.pooled_residual_population_variance: ddof=0 over repeat-prompt cells; includes heterogeneous prompt biases
metric_definitions.mean_within_prompt_repeat_sample_varianc: ddof=1 across independent repeats separately for each fixed prompt, then equal prompt average
metric_definitions.delta_v: -delta_pI; signed bias and signed quantiles reverse the I channel
metric_definitions.coefficients: actual applied coefficients; variance across repeats at fixed prompt; crossfit folds reported separately
metric_definitions.pooled_quantiles: recomputed from concatenated original residual cells within method/n/proposal/case; never mean unit quantiles
metric_definitions.intervals: residual quantiles are descriptive errors, not confidence intervals
metric_definitions.timings: observed blocks, not inferred per-method shares; packet block combines cached scoring, sampling and labels
